what_this_is: The register of makers PlotNua may list from their own public product pages WITHOUT supplier permission, on the founder's decision of 14 October 2026 (Garden Retreat — controlled text-only publication expansion). A row here records a LISTING BASIS, not a permission: it says that PlotNua's factual research about this maker's public products may be shown as text. It grants no image rights, records no consent, and implies no partnership or endorsement.

decision.words: Approve a controlled factual text-only publication pathway for eligible products. The objective is to make PlotNua's existing verified research useful to homeowners, without implying supplier endorsement or reproducing unauthorised imagery.
decision.scope_note: Atlas Product Category Wellness / Sauna only (DISC-001 Garden Retreat). Garden rooms and garden homes are untouched.

never: a row here is never a permission, a grant or a confirmation; supplier_permission is always false
a row here never authorises an image: imagery is always 'none' and the image-rights gate is untouched
a rights record always wins: an organisation with its own rights record is decided by that record and never by this register
a maker who has objected, declined or asked to see a preview before publication does not belong here

product_criteria.maker identity verified: the product's organisation is an Atlas organisation listed here, and its product URL is on a domain this register attributes to that maker (atlas-tools/maker-product-links-v1.json makerDomains)
product_criteria.product page is live: the product's entry in atlas-tools/maker-product-links-v1.json is VERIFIED (HTTPS, maker's own domain, HTTP 200, same-host same-path redirects only, the page names the product)
product_criteria.product type classified: the universe assigns at least one closed kind token
product_criteria.price and price basis evidenced: exactly one Verified EUR price record with a recognised price type; its VAT position is carried over, never inferred
product_criteria.material specifications consistent: Atlas Standards carries no BLOCKED recorded contradiction
product_criteria.source provenance recorded: the product links at least one Atlas Source
product_criteria.no unsupported Irish availability: every wellness record emits Irish availability as UNCONFIRMED; nothing in this pathway can state it
